newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher as uncertainty eases.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher as uncertainty eases.

text.p: Pakistani stocks jumped towards the close on Monday on speculative buying sparked by hopes that Nawaz Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League, perceived as pro-business, would win the February 3 elections, dealers said.
"Sentiment is bullish as political uncertainty has eased and people hope that Nawaz Sharif will win the elections," chief dealer of Taurus Securities Manochar Jamal said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 10.43 points, or 0.76 percent, to end at 1,381.13 amid 81 losers and 75 gainers. PTCL rose 0.50 rupees to 25.20 and Hub Power 0.70 and 34.50.
Adamjee Insurance rose 1.0 rupee to 88.25 rupees, Fazal Textile 0.75 to 22.50 and Dewan Salman Fibre 1.10 to 33.75.
Hub Power Co rose 0.50 to 34.25 and Pakistan State Oil 5.50 to 273. PTCL rose 0.75 to 25.25 and ICI Pakistan 1.25 to 19.55. Fauji Fertilizer was steady at 69.
